title: Couple accepted Mg/Cr hydrate identifier changes to source routing and rejection-ledger owner pins
body:
# Couple accepted Mg/Cr hydrate identifier changes to source routing and rejection-ledger owner pins

This is an integration dependency of the exact unapplied W02 proposals at `0597d00417be4d7cdfb5a31970043eec9bbc88fe`, observed against frozen campaign baseline `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. It is not a claim that either proposed scientific identity has already been applied or that later main is defective.

| Proposed owner transition | Current identity | Proposed identity | Native coupling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `c2-proposal-magnesium-sulfate-hexahydrate-cas` | `kgmicrobe.compound:mgso4_x_6_h2o` | `cas:17830-18-1` | Three source-label routes and the exact rejection-ledger owner pin |
| `b2-proposal-chromium_sulfate_variable_hydrate` | `kgmicrobe.compound:cr2_so43_x_n_h2o` | `cas:15244-38-9` | The exact rejection-ledger owner pin |

W03's full native-consumer audit found this dependency. A separate coordinator read-only reproduction confirms it using unchanged native functions:

1. `mim_identifier_for_occurrence` receives an occurrence with `resolved_identifier: cas:17830-18-1`, but `SOURCE_LABEL_IDENTIFIER_OVERRIDES` returns the old local identity for each of `MgSO4 x 6 H2O`, `MgSO4 x 6H2O` and `MgSO4·6H2O`. The source name is not newly reinterpreted here: the hard-coded routing target is the field that becomes stale after the reviewed owner identifier changes. The monohydrate route still correctly remains `cas:14168-73-1` and must not be altered.
2. `mappings/unified_mapping_rejections.tsv` deliberately requires the existing `mim_id` for exact rows `MgSO4 x 6 H2O` and `Cr2(SO4)3 x n H2O`. Native `check_unified_rejections.check` refuses private successor rows carrying their proposed CAS identities as having lost the curated identity. The parent prohibitions are still valid: CHEBI:32599 and CHEBI:53471 must not reappear as exact hydrate identities.
3. Private controls changing only those owner pins accept the proposed successor row while still refusing a row that republishes the rejected parent. These are mechanical counterfactuals, not identity approval and not a maintained policy edit.

Required sequence: independently accept each complete final owner/form proposal under MAPPING_SEMANTICS, then make its exact routing/ledger migration in the same coupled integration. Preserve all old history, rejected IDs, reasons and unrelated routes. Rebuild native memberships from the exact source occurrence inputs, prove old/new owner attribution and unchanged sibling scopes, and retain scientific holds where the owner is not accepted. Do not globally replace identifiers, alter owner selection, exempt a rejection or use a guessed parent. Keep immutable historical replay expectations separate from current-source successor expectations; maintain wrong-parent and sibling-form negative controls. Required QC and independent final-head review still apply.

Deduplication: live all-state targeted searches and full relevant issue/comment captures found no exact tracker for this pending local-to-CAS coupling. Closed #663 owns the original three-spelling hexahydrate routing repair; closed #892 concerns monohydrate membership. #808/#869 cover wrong-parent unified publication, and #811/#868 cover different label-index defects. #321/#334/#342 supply historical identity/predicate context. #1121's chrome alum decision and #1244 concern the potassium double salt, not this variable chromium sulfate owner. This issue preserves those prior scientific decisions and adds only the integration obligation.

Evidence: `C/preflight/w03-oxoid-source-successor-collection-v1/dependency-coupling/independent-native-reproduction.json`, copied W03 `native-controls.json` and `findings.json`, and the read-only probe source/TSVs. Native source hashes: occurrence utility `847fcee4814d9abb1d5f10d236eb23038eb171e275f3745c23d336b2e958a2be`; rejection checker `4f7faf1f103f50be1a59e826b0238061d1a9214afcec9d1cf0b029237e71238c`; maintained ledger `99ede603cc21505e39d521604e9d411b0287b5cc1d58965b44cc84cba95fec7b`. No maintained write has been made by these probes.
